data.text: I’m on board with the 5-ton reserve and will cap my catch at 19 tons this month if all five agree. In later months, I’ll follow the whole-ton quota John described, based on the actual stock—not an assumed refill. Since one person exceeding the cap could jeopardize everyone’s future income, let’s explicitly confirm our commitments before choosing. Kate, are you in? Emma, would you accept this revision?
